children.name: Psophia
children.description: Medium-sized, long-legged terrestrial birds with a distinctive humped back, soft plumage and a low, booming call from which their common name derives. They are restricted to the Amazon basin and are important seed dispersers in the rainforest ecosystem.

children.name: Psophia crepitans
children.description: The grey-winged trumpeter (Psophia crepitans) is a member of a small family of birds, the Psophiidae. It is found in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, French Guiana, Guyana, Peru, Suriname, and Venezuela.

children.name: Psophia viridis
children.description: The dark-winged trumpeter or green-winged trumpeter (Psophia viridis) is a species of bird in the family Psophiidae. It is endemic to Brazil.

children.name: Psophia leucoptera
children.description: The pale-winged trumpeter (Psophia leucoptera), also known as the white-winged trumpeter, is a species of bird in the family Psophiidae. It is found in the western Amazon rainforest of Bolivia, Brazil, and Peru.
